testCase.name: [本地] S20 Visual lane on the transcript panel: axe collapsed and open in both modes; phone width and WebKit with a 12-line row

descriptionHtml:
缺陷 A5 · P3 · 无障碍

手机上转录里超长不断行的词溢出卡片、末尾被截掉

票：TFA-92594 · 算 QA bug：是 · 在哪发现：本地（视觉巡检）

思路 / Approach · TC-16 Prior Encounter Transcripts · S20 「转写面板上的视觉车道：两种模式下收起和打开时跑 axe；手机宽度和 WebKit，带一行 12 行的」 Visual lane on the transcript panel: axe collapsed and open in both modes; phone width and WebKit with a 12-line row

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U3 Entries display collapsed, each with a line count, and the line count is accurate.（UAT TC-16；TFA-92594 AC 3；TFA-92594 How it works 3）
  • U4 Expanding a collapsed entry shows the correct full transcript: that visit's lines for that patient, all of them, and nothing from another entry.（UAT TC-16；TFA-92594 AC 4；TFA-92594 How it works 4）
  • T1 Functionality and design match the p72 prototype's TranscriptHistory: row style, line-count chip, chevron, one open at a time, and longer lists folded into 'Earlier sessions'.（TFA-92594 AC 1）

测试设计方法：无障碍（accessibility） — 按读屏、键盘、对比度、点按尺寸的规则（axe）查，残障用户也要能用。

Given Visual-lane fixture seeded with the S05, S06 and S09 transcripts plus a line with a 120-character word; Desktop Chromium, Pixel 7 (Chromium) and iPhone 15 (WebKit) profiles

When Run axe on both Encounter tabs, collapsed and with one row expanded; on the phone profiles, expand the 12-line row

Then No serious or critical WCAG 2 A/AA violations. Each row button has an accessible name holding its label and line count, and aria-expanded follows the state. On phones: no horizontal page scroll, every line reachable through the inner scroll, no text covered or clipped, row tap targets at least 24 px / 44 pt

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：visual-checks.ts: axe zero serious or critical; row name matches /lines/ and aria-expanded true only on the open row; overflow / covered / truncated / tap findings = 0 on the new screens; screenshots for a human. S21 (phone width and WebKit) merged here: same visual-lane pass and seeds

在哪跑：本地 visual lane（截图 + axe）；测试方法 VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看）；矩阵里排的车道 视觉 / 移动端（blocked）

S20 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-16.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：新的产品问题 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-92594 ready for qa

在手机上，转录里有超长不断行的词时，那一行超出卡片、末尾被截掉；展开行的滚动框键盘到不了，部分文字对比度不够。

On a phone, a transcript line containing a very long unbroken word runs past the card edge and its end is cut off. The open row's scroll box also cannot be reached by keyboard, and some text fails contrast.

依据：Allure 1d7d481f, visual lane: 36 checks passed, 16 failed. On Pixel 7 and iPhone 15 the paragraph is 318 px wide but the text is 791 px, in the NH prior-visit row and the Hospital Recorded Transcript. The test uses a synthetic 120-character token, so this is a low-frequency edge case. axe also reports scrollable-region-focusable (serious) and contrast. Not in the dev report, ledger or matrix.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane visual。

测试方法：VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：visual。

UAT item: TC-16 Prior Encounter Transcripts · Section: A3 · Encounter · Scenario: TC-16/S20

Tickets: TFA-92594 Prior Encounter Transcripts (ready for qa)

本地新 lane visual：visual/results.json 里 status failed → 失败·产品（失败·产品（lane 标了产品问题））。

怎么测（visual/plan.json，automatable: yes）：encounter.spec.ts: S05/S06/S09-shaped transcriptHistory + a 120-character word; collapsed and one row open, both modes; axe, row names (label + line count), aria-expanded, inner scroll to L12, phone covered/clipped/tap (44 on iPhone). [2026-10-14 review] Re-run with the stricter 'covered' rule (a fixed layer over a fixed layer is high).

Detail:

desktop, iphone15, pixel7: 36 judged check(s) passed, 16 failed. Row buttons carry label + line count; aria-expanded follows the open row; L12 is reached by the inner scroll; tap sizes pass.

产品问题：A transcript line that contains a long unbroken token (the 120-character word) does not wrap: the paragraph is 318 px wide but its text 791 px, so the end of the line is cut off by the card edge on Pixel 7 and iPhone 15 — seen in the Nursing Home prior-visit row and the Hospital Recorded Transcript (oracle: no text covered or clipped). axe also flags the open row's scroll box as not keyboard-focusable (scrollable-region-focusable, serious) plus contrast.

证据：附了 8 个；没附 1 个：

  • visual/evidence/TC-16_S20 — 目录（27 项），不附

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane V: visual-lane.ts reads a make-session.ts fixture (a fresh local account made with the admin key), and make-session.ts refuses dev, so it runs on the local stack only (2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
